method: Unchanged ChunkProviderServer constructed over a stub IChunkLoader (stores TerrainPopulated, LightPopulated, InhabitedTime and hasEntities; logs load/save/saveExtra/chunkTick/saveExtraData) and a stub generator (logs provideChunk/populate/recreateStructures). WorldServer, PlayerManager and EntityPlayerMP are allocated without constructors; only the fields these methods read are set; saveLevel is a no-op; the provider has no sky, so Chunk.func_150809_p does no lighting. Ticks run unloadQueuedChunks, totalWorldTime + 1, PlayerManager.updatePlayerInstances in WorldServer.tick order; prepare is MinecraftServer.initialWorldChunkLoad's loop. No block-change packets, chunk sending, entity or tile entity code. Set records are Collections.newSetFromMap(ConcurrentHashMap) iteration orders over seeded add/remove/remove-first op lists on the probe JVM (19.0.1). Snapshot fields: loaded = [x, z, flags (1 populated, 2 light populated, 4 modified, 8 hasEntities, 16 loaded), lastSaveTime, inhabitedTime] per chunk in loadedChunks order; queue = unload set order; watchers = [x, z, players, previousWorldTime] in playerInstanceList order; sends = each player's loadedChunks (send queue); a null field is unchanged since the previous step.
